mapper.sql: select id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload_json, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_at, last_error, created_at, processed_at from wf_outbox_event
mapper.select: where status = 'PENDING' and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now}) order by created_at asc limit #{limit}
where aggregate_id = #{aggregateId} order by created_at asc
mapper.insert: insert into wf_outbox_event (id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload_json, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_at, last_error, created_at, processed_at) values (#{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetries}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{lastError}, #{createdAt}, #{processedAt})
